A.alph.hyp: X a finite set of integer tuples

A.env.stmt: φ̂_ij(v) = max{ x_i : x ∈ X, x_j ≤ v }; max ∅ = −∞

A.R.stmt: ℛ(X) = { x ∈ ∏_i Â_i(X) : x_i ≤ φ̂_ij(x_j) ∀ i≠j }

A.clos.stmt: ℛ is extensive, monotone, idempotent; the closed sets form a Moore family

A.fix.hyp: each coordinate presented as a chain

A.bpc.stmt: X ⊆ BPC(X) ⊆ ℛ(X), BPC(X) = { x : (x_i,x_j) ∈ proj_ij(X) ∀ i<j }

A.gc.stmt: E(X) = 0 ⟺ the binary constraint network is globally consistent
A.gc.hyp: the constraints are the monotone binary projections

A.freuder.stmt: a tree-structured constraint network is globally consistent after arc consistency

A.montanari.stmt: for monotone constraints, path consistency implies global consistency

A.rule.stmt: a tightening preserves E = 0 iff it binds one coordinate by a monotone function of one other
A.rule.hyp: the index is a sublattice of a product of chains

A.morph.stmt: an occupancy coordinate's cap is admissible iff it is a morphism for the operation preserved
A.morph.hyp: meet-morphism preserves meets; join-morphism preserves joins

A.modeA.stmt: sub-case A, ORDERING: the term is present and determined but non-monotone; repairable by re-ordering
A.modeA.hyp: the term is a function of an existing coordinate

A.modeB.stmt: sub-case B, ARITY: every term is monotone; the constraint names more coordinates than an envelope has arguments; not repairable by any operation on coordinates
A.modeB.hyp: the minimal failing support has size ≥ 3

A.derived.stmt: a derived coordinate cannot repair closure: the box grows by its value count and |X| is fixed
A.derived.hyp: the coordinate is a function of the others

A.dens.stmt: E = 0 is informative at any density; E > 0 at low density measures sparsity

A.prod.stmt: if no constraint links the factors, ℛ(A×B) = ℛ(A)×ℛ(B)
A.prod.hyp: A, B on disjoint coordinate sets, no cross constraint

A.slack.stmt: SLACK(S) = measure(ambient)/measure(S); log SLACK = log|ℛ(X)| − log|X|

L.c8.hyp: a cell is a transition, not a state

L.def.hyp: caps stated; figures at other caps must say so (§7.4)

L.closed.stmt: Λ is closed under coordinatewise ∨ and ∧
L.closed.hyp: every constraint of the form x_i ≤ φ(x_j) with φ non-decreasing

L.E0.hyp: at the stated caps; verified at four settings and through the f shell

L.dist.stmt: Λ is distributive (a sublattice of a product of chains)

L.modular.stmt: rank(a∨b) + rank(a∧b) = rank(a) + rank(b), rank = Σx_i

L.birk.stmt: Λ ≅ down-sets of J(Λ); |J(Λ)| = 17, 20 covering relations

L.alpha.hyp: each generator is min{x ∈ Λ : x_c ≥ v} for one coordinate and one value

L.sperner.stmt: the largest antichain equals the largest rank level; max 122 at rank 11

L.skew.stmt: centre of mass 11.0666 vs midpoint 11.5, skew −0.43; only 8 of 976 cells fixed by x ↦ max − x

L.dim.stmt: order dimension of Λ₈ is 8, rising by one per adjoined axis

L.arith.stmt: N(x) = ∏_i p_i^{x_i}; x≤y ⟺ N(x)|N(y); ∨↦lcm, ∧↦gcd, rank ↦ Ω(N)

L.metric.stmt: log d is an ℓ¹ metric; d(x,z) ≤ d(x,y)·d(y,z)

L.mobius.stmt: μ(x,y) = (−1)^{|y∖x|} if y∖x is an antichain in J(Λ), else 0
L.mobius.named: Möbius function of a distributive lattice

L.voidfrac.stmt: void-free fraction 27.7–30.1% across 776M pairs; joint 30.13% vs product 20.19%, factor 1.49

L.box.stmt: |box ∩ Λ| factorises because the constraint graph is a tree; no Möbius sieve needed

L.tree.stmt: constraint graph n—ℓ—k—q—g—f—e with 2S pendant at k: 8 nodes, 7 edges, a caterpillar; treewidth 1
L.tree.hyp: every constraint binds exactly two coordinates

L.F.stmt: F = Σ_n z₁ⁿ Σ_{ℓ≤n−1} z₂^ℓ Σ_{k≤4ℓ+2} z₃^k [Σ_{S≤k} z₈^S] Σ_{q≤k} z₄^q Σ_e z₅^e Σ_{f<e} z₆^f Σ_{g≤min(q,4f+2)} z₇^g
L.F.hyp: at stated caps; the tree has no cycles so the sum factorises

L.Fm1.stmt: F(−1) = 2, because ℓ and f each have exactly two consecutive values but are coupled to n and e

L.pal.stmt: F palindromic ⟺ the poset is self-dual; Λ's F is not palindromic

L.chi.stmt: χ(x) = H(n−1−ℓ)H(4ℓ+2−k)H(k−q)H(k−2S)H(e−1−f)H(4f+2−g)H(q−g); the coefficient function of F is χ

L.total.stmt: χ_Λ : ∏A_i → {0,1} is total: membership decided for every ambient point
L.total.hyp: Λ a finite intersection of decidable comparisons

L.bits.stmt: Λ is the 976 words in {0,1}¹⁷ that are down-sets of J(Λ); join = OR, meet = AND; 17 bits carried, 9.93 needed, 7.07 surplus

L.circuit.stmt: the 20 covering relations, as implications, cut 2¹⁷ = 131,072 words to exactly 976, at depth 5
L.circuit.hyp: monotone: AND, OR, implication; no NOT, no feedback

L.chains.stmt: maximal chains of Λ = linear extensions of J(Λ) = 1,113,045,672

L.pushback.stmt: no cell of Λ₈ is both join-prime and meet-prime, so pushback ≥ 16 > 0 for every cell

L.step.stmt: X ∖ [a,b] is a sublattice iff a is join-prime and b is meet-prime; step(Λ₈) = 4

L.amp.stmt: A(y) = N[φ(Λ ∪ {y})] − N[φ(Λ)] − 1; median 340, minimum 59 over 220 trials

C.cut.stmt: every two-sided cut of the tree gives defect zero, not only q
C.cut.hyp: the tree is doing the work, not the transfer

C.Aq.hyp: caps as stated; q held fixed

C.box.hyp: every fibre bottoms out in a product of chains

C.local.stmt: E(Λ) = 0 and E(A_q) = E(B_q) = 0 for every q; the second does not follow from the first

C.pareto.stmt: |A(q)| falls 33,33,23,8 while |B(q)| rises 5,10,15,17; no q improves both

C.qmean.stmt: ⟨q⟩ = 1.4631, sd 0.930; peak at q = 2 with 345 cells (35.3%)

T.a9p.stmt: 2S′ ≤ 2f+1 (the admissible Pauli cut); Λ₉′ = 1,561 cells, 93 removed; closes the cycle f–g–2S′

T.a11.stmt: 2J_c ≤ φ̂(k), φ̂ = max 2J over terms of ℓ^k = {1:3, 2:4, 3:5}
T.a11.hyp: φ̂ read off the realised extent, not from a law

T.tower.stmt: Λ₈…Λ₁₃ = 976, 1654, 2535, 13585, 70905, 199130; E = 0 at every stage, swept against every ambient cell to 47,775,744

T.dich.stmt: counting coordinates close exactly; coupling coordinates close as envelopes; no third kind
T.dich.hyp: the exact coupling bound is made of reflection, congruence and triangle

T.excl.stmt: three excluded forms: REFLECTION (particle–hole conjugation), CONGRUENCE (fermion parity), TRIANGLE (one sum and one difference)

T.para.stmt: capacity(ℓ) = m(4ℓ+2) for parastatistics of order m; E = 0 through Λ₁₃ for m = 1,2,3
T.para.hyp: m(4ℓ+2) monotone in ℓ for every m, so A.rule is preserved

T.scheme.stmt: closure holds in LS, LK, jK, jj: Λ₁₃ = 431,050 / 341,150 / 199,130 / 206,520, E = 0 throughout

T.trad.stmt: the tree or the tightness: imposing the exact triangle at axis 12 gives 22,275 cells and E = 35,570
T.trad.hyp: the exact bound has two parents

K.comp.stmt: b∘a defined when tgt(a) = src(b); the composite transfers min(q_a, q_b)
K.comp.hyp: Λ₉'s target (e,f,g,2S′) has the source's constraint forms

K.cat.stmt: Λ₉ is a category: 41,682 composable pairs, zero failures, associative

K.window.stmt: Λ₉ is the first composable level and the last tree level
K.window.hyp: Λ₈ target has 3 coordinates against 4; Λ₁₀ has 10 nodes and 10 edges

K.quiver.stmt: composable cells are the arcs of a quiver Q on 33 objects; the composition graph is the line digraph L(Q), |E| = Σ_v in(v)·out(v) = 27,027

K.girth.stmt: the girth of the unit-step graph on Λ₉ is exactly 4

K.clock.stmt: occupancy never rises along composition: 0 of 739 steps; the tick is k − g = (k−q) + (q−g)
K.clock.hyp: destinations begin empty -- an assumption, not a constraint

K.clockfail.stmt: index (g,G) with g ≤ G ≤ 4f+2 and g ≤ q: 13,775 cells, closed, and 31.6% of composable pairs raise occupancy
K.clockfail.hyp: prior occupancy carried as a coordinate

K.arrow.stmt: X_w = {a : w(tgt a) ≤ w(src a)} is closed; one arrow per coordinate and no others; sums, max and min all fail

K.markov.stmt: the future is conditionally independent of the past given the transfer: every past gives the same future set at each q
K.markov.hyp: the constraint graph is a tree, q the cut vertex

K.decay.stmt: for a tree-structured index, I(u;v) is non-increasing in tree distance d, and |P(A_u∩A_v) − P(A_u)P(A_v)| ≤ √(I(u;v)·ln2 / 2)
K.decay.hyp: Markov random field on a tree; data processing; Pinsker

K.helly.stmt: molecular transit is an intersection question; the Helly number is ≥ 5 and ≤ 144
K.helly.hyp: a molecule moves as one fibre; a circuit is a square; ground set C(9,2)·4 = 144

B.brk.stmt: T(n) lies between T(n−1) and T(n+1)
B.brk.hyp: T monotone in n within a channel

B.V43.stmt: V = 4ν/3 for a Rydberg series; in general V(x,p) = 4x/(h|p−1|) for y = x^p

B.Vexact.stmt: V = 4ν³/(h(3ν²−h²)); with r = ν/h, V = 4r³/(3r²−1). Z and R cancel identically

B.floor2.stmt: V > 2 for any monotone sequence; V → 2 only as one step vanishes

B.floor32.stmt: V ≥ 32/11 = 2.909 for a Rydberg series specifically

B.pole.stmt: V has a pole at p = 1: a linear observable has no curvature to price

B.pareto.stmt: dw/dh > 0 and dV/dh < 0 for every monotone convex y and every h; the family {(w,V)} is a Pareto frontier

B.hstar.stmt: h* = √(2β/(α y″)) minimises αw + βV, valid for h* ≪ ν

B.frac.stmt: w/T = 4(h/ν) + 8(h/ν)³ and e/T = 3(h/ν)²; their ratio is V

B.newton.stmt: 8y′²/y″ = 8λ² with λ² = ∇f ᵀ[∇²f]⁻¹∇f; for a Rydberg series λ² = (2/3)T

B.aitken.stmt: Aitken's Δ² on a Rydberg series lands at I − T/3, because the correction is (ΔT)²/Δ²T → (2/3)T

B.nuV.hyp: curvature resolvable at quotation granularity q

B.ordk.hyp: the (k+1)-th difference is a signed sum of 2^{k+1} levels

B.ordbr.stmt: sign(f(n) − p(n)) = (−1)^{k+1}(−1)^m with m nodes above n; a two-sided deductive bracket at every order

B.fail.hyp: a perturber reorders only if the shift exceeds half the local spacing

B.silence.stmt: the bracket holding ⟹ |ΔT| < 2Z²R/ν³ at that cell

B.rank1.stmt: rank(log q) = 1 across fifteen Rydberg observables; second singular value 1.8×10⁻¹⁴
B.rank1.hyp: every observable is ν to a power

W.core9.stmt: at nine letters: 2,370 cells, E = 30 = 1 × 30, core (X=0, U=0, NEC=3)

W.supp.stmt: of 414 coordinate subsets excluding {X,U,NEC}, 0 fail: the triple is the unique minimal failing subset, arity exactly 3

W.core15.stmt: at fifteen letters: 18,072 cells, E = 816 = 1 × 816, core (X_exp=0, U_ghost=0, NEC_pt=3, EOM=2nd)

W.scale.stmt: the defect does not scale: core = 1 at 4, 5, 7 and 9 coordinates; only the multiplicity moves (3,5,10,30)

W.frontier.hyp: the fifteen-letter alphabet; d_P the L1 distance on the eleven free letters

W.jur.stmt: a jurisdicted forcing and an unjurisdicted disjunction give identical defects; arity ≥ 3 makes a defect possible, jurisdiction narrowness makes it small
W.jur.hyp: the scope condition is a coordinate

W.rel.stmt: a term that is a relation between two vocabularies cannot be a coordinate of either
W.rel.hyp: the BFV partition A : Loc → Alg has four parts

W.onehot.stmt: status is one bit per vocabulary and the partition forces one-hot: 35 of 40 terms weight 1, 2 weight 0, 3 weight 2
W.onehot.hyp: weight 2 = relation or unsplit conflation; weight 0 = ungrounded or constructible

M.rs.stmt: the vacuum is cyclic and separating for local algebras
M.rs.hyp: Hadamard state; region with nonempty causal complement

M.tt.stmt: for (M,Ω) there exist Δ, J with Δ^{it} M Δ^{−it} = M
M.tt.hyp: M a von Neumann algebra, Ω cyclic and separating

M.hsmi.stmt: half-sided modular inclusion is CHARACTERISED by a one-parameter unitary group with positive generator
M.hsmi.hyp: common cyclic separating vector; extended to weights by Araki–Zsidó 2004

M.takesaki.stmt: N = M ⋊_{σ^φ} ℝ is type II_∞ with trace τ, τ∘θ_s = e^{−s}τ, and M = N ⋊_θ ℝ uniquely
M.takesaki.hyp: M type III, φ a faithful semifinite normal weight; STATED FOR ℝ

M.semi.stmt: a semifinite factor carries a trace, hence an entropy; type III carries none

M.C1.stmt: the presymplectic potential θ = δφ £_ℓφ η carries no transverse derivative, so Ω is block diagonal in y and {φ(u,y),φ(u′,y′)} = (1/4√q(y))sgn(u−u′)δ^{d−2}(y−y′)

M.C2.stmt: Δ_{M(u₁)}^{it} M(u₂) Δ_{M(u₁)}^{−it} ⊆ M(u₂) for t ≤ 0, u₁ < u₂
M.C2.hyp: N a non-expanding horizon with no Killing field, ω Hadamard

M.ledger.stmt: d − 1 = 1 + (d − 2): one HSMI per generator supplies the affine line; the transverse direct integral is C1 and no HSMI supplies it
M.ledger.hyp: a null hypersurface in d dimensions

M.sorce.stmt: any geometric modular flow must be generated by a conformal Killing field

A.two.stmt: a tightening preserves E = 0 iff each binary projection is the intersection of that projection's own two upper envelopes

A.stair.stmt: phi-hat recovers a STAIRCASE constraint: (alpha,beta)-monotone with alpha,beta in {<=,>=}

A.dechter.stmt: strong (w*+1)-consistency on induced width w* gives decomposability

A.cert.stmt: an open index does not close itself except where a CERTIFICATE exhibits an operation on its coordinate system reaching a fixed point of R

A.expr.stmt: a closed index equals the set its own envelopes admit, so its expression always exists and is recoverable

S.bounds.stmt: S3: the bounds are recoverable from the cells

I.interval.stmt: delta = f - l is an INTERVAL MAP: min(da,db) <= delta(a v b), delta(a ^ b) <= max(da,db)

I.convex.stmt: delta^-1(T) is a sublattice iff T intersect range(delta) is convex in range(delta)

I.shape.stmt: between any two points there is an interval and the method returns its measure; three objects, one shape

EM.map.stmt: the multipole is determined by |Δl| and parity alone: 0->M1, 1->E1, 2->E2, 3->E3

EM.image.stmt: Λ₉'s image on (multipole, ΔS) is the COMPLETE rectangle at every cap; E = 0 vacuously

EM.spin.stmt: ΔS = 0 is a diagonal, hence two monotone one-parent bounds; imposing it preserves E = 0 at four cap settings

EM.parity.stmt: |Δl| = 1 is delta^-1({-1,+1}), a hole at zero, not convex; E = 750

EM.quotient.stmt: the EM index is a QUOTIENT of Λ, not an extension: adjoining its coordinates gives E = 3,900

EM.notcomp.stmt: composability and the EM condition share 0.0004 bits of a possible 0.633

T.invariant.stmt: the exact J multiset is identical in jK, LS, LK and jj; the four cell counts price four ROUTES
T.invariant.named: basis independence of the level set

G.book.stmt: E(book) = 578 at chapter resolution, 0 at part resolution; a certificate exists

G.reg.stmt: E(register) = 6 at 68.8% density, and R recovers repair <= phi(corroboration)
G.reg.hyp: coordinates assigned from the entry text

G.ref.stmt: the reference index: 38 cells, box 144, E = 0, and NOT a tree -- access closes a cycle

G.trip.stmt: independence is a property of TRIPLES: surviving tests go as (1-f)^3, not (1-f)
G.trip.hyp: the bracket relates T(n-1), T(n), T(n+1)
